trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing separate to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide in order: story first, then contacts and strangers, then collectibles, then activities, and finally the money and 100% completion cleanup. Keep this checklist open as you play so nothing gets left behind.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Follow the roadmap stages 1 to 6 in this guide.
The platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion and this gold trophy pops — it is the last big gate before the platinum. The game's own completion stat (in the pause menu or stats screen) is the source of truth: it counts story, side strands, collectibles and activities together. Do it last, after the roadmap's stages 1 to 5, then use this guide's checklist to find whatever the stat says is still missing. Anything that feeds the stat and is still undone will show up as an un-ticked trophy here.
steps: Finish the story, side strands, collectibles and activities first.
Check the game's completion stat to see what is missing.
Clear the remaining items, then the gold pops at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across the game — jumps, near misses, drifts and the like, whatever the game counts as a stunt. This is a slow burn, not a sprint: the count builds up over a whole playthrough if you drive fast and take every ramp and jump you see. Do not grind it in one sitting; instead, stunt whenever you travel, and mop up the remainder in free roam after the story by chaining jumps on open roads.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and near misses whenever you travel.
Let the count build naturally through the story.
After the story, chain stunts in free roam until the counter hits 250.

You only need to try each type, not master it: one go at each is enough for the trophy to pop.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — every challenge on the range's list, at gold standard. This is the hardest skill trophy on the list: gold means fast, accurate shooting with few misses. Work through the challenges one at a time, repeat the ones you fail until the pattern clicks, and take breaks rather than grinding frustrated. Different weapons suit different challenges, so switch weapons when one challenge keeps beating you.

Work through the 42 challenges, earning gold in each.
Repeat failed challenges until they click — switch weapons if one keeps beating you.
